coverage: Eight divisions, 64 districts, 495 upazilas and 12 separately identified city corporations, BBS / HDX administrative reference valid May 2023. Parent geometry is derived from the same local shapes. Official 2022 final enumerated division/district populations from BBS National Report Volume I Table 01 sum to 165,158,616, including slum and floating population. They are not the adjusted national total. No local population counts or Bengali subdivision names are inferred; country name is bilingual. Chattogram, Cumilla, Barishal and other modern names retain source aliases. Shared display boundaries follow existing India and Myanmar edges; actual coastal water is independent of political outlines.
processing: Full available source resolution retained, cleaned together and rounded to six decimal places. Shared internal edges stored once; unselected coasts have no stroke. Deeper geometry loads only for the selected region. All views use the shared regional renderer, selected-outline index, adaptive detail, lifecycle and three-country cache. Territorial waters are excluded from land fills. Territory context features carry their own destination bounds.

bangladesh-boundaries.zip.description:
Bangladesh administrative level 0-3 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 03.  
  
This dataset is structured into 3 levels:  
- Admin 1: 8 Division  
- Admin 2: 64 District  
- Admin 3: 507 Upazila  
  
  
Note: The normal administrative level 3 feature type(s) are Upazila (495 features) and City Corporation (12 units).  
  
  
Dates associated with this dataset:  
- 01 June 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness  
- 21 May 2023: valid for use by the humanitarian community  
- 01 June 2025: last edit to the dataset before publishing  
- 01 January 2010: boundaries created by the source

Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx).
